turns.content: Paanch hafte pehle layoff ho gaya mera. Poori team gayi, market ka scene tha, performance ka nahi — dimaag se toh pata hai mujhe. Ab woh baat jo main kisi se keh nahi pa raha: main ab bhi roz subah nau baje laptop bag leke ghar se nikalta hoon. Chhe baje tak café. Wife ko nahi pata. Parents aajkal hamare saath hi ruke hain. Kisi ko nahi pata.

Paanch hafte... aur har subah ab bhi bag utha ke nikalna. Woh weight samajh sakta hoon main.

Market thi, performance nahi — yeh dimaag se pata hona alag baat hai, aur seene mein jo baith jaata hai na, woh alag. Especially jab ghar pe wife hai, parents aa rahe hain, aur tum akela yeh poora scene carry kar rahe ho. Café tak jaana, chhe baje tak baithna — jaise abhi bhi ek structure hai, ek wajah hai ghar se nikalne ki. Samajh aa raha hai kyun.

Yahan bilkul safe hai kehna. Koi judgment nahi.  
Abhi mann kaisa hai, isi pal?

Do hafte mein cousin ki shaadi hai. Teen sau log, aadhe woh rishtedaar jo sabke careers stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Papa meri company ke naam se introduce karte hain — pichli Diwali chacha ko mera package bataya tha, proudly, sach mein proud hoke. Neend nahi aati toh wahi kamra dimaag mein chalta hai.

Do hafte. Teen sau log. Aur woh sawaal jo air mein tairte rehte hain — "Ab kahan ho? Company kaisi chal rahi? Package?"

Papa proudly introduce karte hain company ke naam se, pichli Diwali package bata diya tha chacha ko. Woh proud hona... abhi usi cheez ka weight ban gaya hai. Neend nahi aati toh dimaag usi kamre mein chala jata hai — log, sawaal, unke chehre, papa ka chehra. Bilkul natural hai.

Yeh secret abhi bhi sirf tumhare aur mere beech hai. Wife, parents, koi nahi jaanta. Shaadi se pehle batana hai ya baad mein, ya bilkul alag se sochna hai — woh tum decide karoge jab ready feel karo. Abhi sirf yeh kaafi hai ki tumne yahan rakh diya.

Us kamre ka scene jab dimaag mein chalta hai, sabse zyada kaunsa hissa bhaari lagta hai? Papa ka reaction, relatives ke sawaal, ya khud ka "main kya bolunga"?

Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon shaadi skip hi kar doon — bol doon release hai, office ki deadline hai, kuch bhi. Jhooth bolna aasaan hai us se, ki papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne badalte hue dekhoon. Bahut galat hai kya yeh? Ek shaam hai, ek bahana, aur main shaadi ki story nahi banunga.

Nahi, bahut galat nahi hai.

Jo tum soch rahe ho woh cowardice nahi hai — protection hai. Papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne change hote dekhna... woh dard tum pehle se hi feel kar rahe ho, neend se pehle. Ek jhooth, ek shaam skip karke us scene se bachna — dimaag ke liye abhi sabse sasta option lag raha hai. Samajh aa raha hai.

Lekin ek chhoti si baat aur hai jo saath mein baithi hai: skip karne ke baad bhi secret toh rahega. Ghar pe wapas aake bhi wahi laptop-bag wali routine, wahi chhupana. Shaadi ki story nahi banoge, lekin apni kahani abhi bhi adhoori rahegi.

Tumhare liye abhi sabse bhaari kya hai — relatives ke saamne expose hone ka khauf, ya Papa ko disappoint karne ka khayal? Dono alag-alag weights hain.

Paison ka aisa hai ki teen mahine nikal jayenge, phir EMI savings khaana shuru kar degi. Khud ko yahi bolta rehta hoon ki offer haath mein aate hi sabko bata dunga — tab woh sirf news hogi, crisis nahi. Yeh jhooth toh nahi hua na? Bas... timing hai? Kabhi yeh logic bilkul solid lagta hai aur kabhi lagta hai ulti aa jayegi.

Nahi, seedha jhooth nahi hai.

Tum timing chuna rahe ho — jab haath mein kuch ho, tab batana, taaki woh sirf update rahe, breakdown na bane. Paise teen mahine chalenge, uske baad EMI savings ko khayegi, yeh bhi clear hai. Isliye dimaag yeh logic banata hai: pehle offer, phir reveal. Kabhi yeh bilkul solid aur kind lagta hai apne aap pe, kabhi pet mein ulati jaisi kyunki andar se pata hai ki secret roz bhaari ho raha hai.

Dono feelings saath ho sakti hain. Na tum bure ho is strategy ke liye, na weak. Bas ek aadmi hai jo apne logon ko protect karna chahta hai, aur khud ko bhi.

Abhi jo sabse zyada tight kar raha hai — teen mahine ka countdown, ya yeh soch ki “kya jab tak offer nahi aata tab tak chhupa paunga?”
